description: Get full place details, including canonical sheet content plus retained sidecar associated_characters and tags as compatibility/review notes. Use connect_character_place_evidence when scene-backed character/place evidence is paired, or connect_scene_place_evidence when scene evidence is place-only. Response shape note: returns a structured envelope (`results`, `total_count`) with one result row.

place_id.description: The place_id to look up (e.g. 'place-harbor-district'). Use list_places to find valid IDs.

name: get_place_sheet
